# Examined-source response: offline source qualification

HP-23, [0048/ES](../../../designs/prose-examined-source-review.md). This qualifies
versioned command-local behavior, not real model quality, document acceptance or
UI entry. [Receipt](receipt.json) binds the tested source and instruments.

| Instrument | Observation |
|---|---|
| Legacy native request goldens | All85 protocol /3 bodies retain their exact frozen hashes |
| Retained actual failed /3 journal | New code reproduces the original failed report byte-for-byte, exit2, without credentials or provider calls |
| Injected-native /4 cohort | All85 capture/replay positions match synthetic responses, including32 Supported,52 Unsupported and1 Inconclusive |
| Terminal controls | Planted false support, invalid examined list and pre-dispatch missing credential each stop the next call and retain84 missing positions |
| Disclosure and identity | Default reports hide decisions/claims/source IDs; explicit full reports retain examined/premise/counter lists; changed protocol markers refuse |
| Go/CUE and native codec | Required/null/duplicate/byte-bound/list/source/subset and cross-version controls pass |
| Actual key-free /4 CLI | Prepare0, capture2, report2; one failed and84 missing positions, no native reservation and no charge |

Independent review found newly optional artifact fields widened old /3 grammar.
The owner reproduced two failures for added empty protocol fields on a marker and
receipt. Original strict JSON decoding already refused nulls. The repaired reader
checks the selected exact key set before typed decoding for marker, successful or
held receipt, and reason. Red/green tests and independent re-review closed the
finding. Original emitted /3 artifacts and the old response decoder stay intact.

The synthetic transport deliberately supplies expected labels. Its85 matches are
workflow/codec evidence and cannot measure model accuracy. Examined IDs remain a
model declaration, not authenticated attention or truth. No library API, external
consumer, app-kit dependency, installed command, hook or global registration changed.
The next real study requires a separate freeze, identity and reconciled prior spend.
The failed real protocol3 study remains failed. HP-01/03/06/09 and PH/HW remain open.
